configuration.scope: Exploratory CPU confidence-head study on frozen Foundation representations and the earlier selected RLOO readout. Neither active study candidate list changes.
configuration.fold_policy: All related views share a fold. The six procedural training families are sorted by seeded SHA and assigned cyclically to folds, withholding two entire families for each out-of-fold readout. Other domains split by seeded group hash. No development/calibration/final label enters these readout fits.
configuration.fold_classifier: Reinitialize the original Foundation readout for each fold; original RLOO+CE, optimizer, group batches, temperatures, domain shares and retention anchoring. Fixed epoch count matches the earlier selected full-data classifier. No early selection on withheld groups.
configuration.critic_input: Parameter-free LayerNorm of the same 2048-dimensional request state, maximum probability, top-two margin, entropy/log(candidate_count), probability square sum, candidate_count/16, and one-hot question type. No family, domain, gold, observed-condition labels, case identity, or parsed rules at inference.
configuration.critic_target: Expected correctness of the out-of-fold predicted option: 1/0 versus hard gold, or stated conditional target mass for soft-only observations. Train BCE under the original domain shares; keep class decisions and distributions unchanged.
configuration.comparison: Evaluate once on original development groups after all declared critic epochs. Compare original maximum probability and each critic as answer-ordering scores. Report fixed-count 60% per-type error, threshold coverage under 15% error, and uncertain expected cost at 80% coverage. No threshold fitted for deployment.
configuration.promotion_screen: Median over three critic seeds must reach >=60% coverage at <=15% error for every type and must not increase uncertainty cost at 80% coverage versus the same classifier. Representative seed is 173 regardless of favorable outliers. This screen is exploratory, not release approval.
configuration.limitations: Cross-fitting excludes labels only from the new readout fits; the frozen parent previously adapted on some legacy training domains. This is not cross-fitting the backbone and not the live backbone candidate. Public pretraining overlap remains unknown.
configuration.publication: A useful pilot still requires a separately declared whole-model study, exact runtime integration, unchanged release gates and final isolation. Do not add it to either active candidate list.
configuration.relationship_to_prior_work: Inspired by learned rejection/confidence heads. This pilot predicts out-of-fold expected correctness, not ConfidNet TCP, and does not reproduce SelectiveNet end-to-end selective training or claim a novel algorithm.
